summary: Shortly after the 2025 Christmas break, Higham Lane School in Nuneaton, Warwickshire was hit by a serious cyberattack that took down phones, email, servers and the school management system, as well as physical safety systems including electronic gates, the fire alarm and electronic registers. The school closed on advice from the Department for Education and police, reopened in stages, and returned all year groups to full-time teaching on January 19, 2026 with very limited IT access. The school confirmed the attack involved removal of data and reported it to the ICO. No group had claimed the attack.
